build.beforeDevCommand: bun run prepare:sidecar:dev && bun run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run prepare:sidecar:release && bun run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* ws://127.0.0.1:* ws://localhost:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'
